text: FINALLY, an app without premium features! I liked it a lot, but there are a few things that need adjustments. First, for tasks that must be done 5 times, don’t mark them as done unless I complete all 5/5. You can make that optional, but it's important to encourage users to complete the full goal. Second, the weekly view feels a bit broken—I’m not sure how to explain it, but it could use some improvement. Overall, I’m really satisfied! ❤️
author: Eyad Tamer
developer_reply:
Thank you so much for the lovely review and thoughtful feedback! 😊 We're glad you appreciate the ad-free experience. We'll definitely consider your suggestions to improve task tracking and the weekly view. Your support means a lot!
Please check the update we have published will resolve most of queries, may require clear data or reinstall...

text: Certain things to correct: The description of habits fails to reupdate once I already put it in, I cannot arrange habits in my order, the long press to undo a habit hangs the screen. Things I love: the ability to put multiple habits in one category and see the statistics of the category. This feature is missing in most apps. Things I would add: time period option (eg. start date and end date) for apps and stats for those time periods. Looking forward to the corrections. Thank you developer.
